overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies spray dried apple powder for food manufacturers, brands, and ingredient distributors who need consistent bulk supply from India. The powder is made from selected apples and processed to deliver a fine, uniform texture with 80-100 mesh sizing. It is suitable for formulations that need easy mixing, stable storage, and dependable batch-to-batch consistency.

Our process flow follows a 6-step process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, with OEM and private label support available on request. MOQ starts at 5 Kg, with samples, export documentation support, and custom mesh or packaging options available.
